subject.title: fix(mac-gateway): write launchd stderr to a log file and surface it in diagnostics (#90711)

question: Should file-backed macOS launchd stderr ship before bounded retention covers the exact supervisor log path?
rationale: The patch fixes irretrievably lost crash evidence but changes a shipped supervisor default to an unbounded persistent file, and tests cannot determine which operational tradeoff maintainers want.

options.title: Pair capture with retention
options.body: Land stderr capture only with bounded retention for `resolveGatewaySupervisorLogPaths` and real fresh-install plus rewrite proof.

options.title: Accept temporary growth risk
options.body: Land after real macOS proof while explicitly accepting unbounded supervisor stderr until a separately owned retention fix ships.

options.title: Preserve suppression
options.body: Keep `/dev/null` and accept that early launchd crash stderr remains unavailable to operators and diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Pair capture with retention
recommendation.body: Land stderr capture only with bounded retention for `resolveGatewaySupervisorLogPaths` and real fresh-install plus rewrite proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the launchd default and lifecycle decision.
